program.title: BEng in Civil Engineering
uncertain: total_required_credits (86.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups, using the lower bound for credit ranges (COMP 3-5, MATH 4-6, CIVL Research Option 1-4). The Research Option is optional; its required (1) and elective (3) credits are included, but a student would complete at most one option.

CIVL 3610 is listed both as an option (CIVL 3210 OR CIVL 3610) and as a standalone required course in the PDF; the JSON follows the printed structure (the standalone required group sums to 18 including 3610).
Remarks in the PDF note that COMP 1022P was last offered in 2024-25 and deleted subsequently; it is kept in the list as printed in the PDF.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 CIVL (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2026-27 intake curriculum.
